about_the_game:
Elijah Reed, a seasoned agent for the Ministry of Mysteries, is no stranger to pulse-pounding missions and high-stakes challenges. So when he's dispatched to the quiet Norwegian town of Bergen, he's ready for monsters, mythical creatures, and ancient magic. But what do you pack when you're tasked with saving the world from certain doom? What gift do you bring to a mighty Valkyrie and a magical squirrel? And, most pressing of all, does the Ministry's expense account cover inter-dimensional travel through the realms of Yggdrasil?

This Collector's Edition includes:

🗝️ Hidden Objects!

Find hidden objects in breathtaking locations across the realms of Yggdrasil! Search for lost relics in Asgard, track down myths and monsters in Midgard, and uncover powerful artifacts hidden deep within Jotunheim!

🗝️ Mind-bending Puzzles!

Solve puzzle adventure games with the intrigue of detective games! Outsmart Loki’s tricks, unlock magical artifacts, and follow an ancient prophecy before time runs out. These immersive challenges make item search games more exciting than ever!

🗝️ Explore the mythical World Tree!

Travel through Midgard, Jotunheim, and even Asgard as you gather clues, meet legendary beings, and uncover the truth behind the coming of Ragnarok. With every new location, there are hidden object games moments that require sharp observation and critical thinking!

🗝️ Heart-racing Storyline!

Item search games, Norse mythology, and high-stakes espionage! You’ll need to find hidden objects, analyze evidence, and solve complex cases to protect humanity from the wrath of the gods. A must-play for fans of detective games, this epic adventure will keep you on the edge of your seat!
